GH-663: fresh init must install and surface the semantic merge fence

Make the SDK-backed init lifecycle install the committed .gitattributes merge mappings and clone-local git driver configuration by default, preserve an explicit opt-out, and provide actionable recovery when a raw conflict reveals a missing fence.

Public SDK workspace-init primitives own a typed merge-fence policy; CLI init is a thin adapter with an explicit opt-out; fresh git repositories merge concurrent non-overlapping item/history edits without raw conflicts after init; status/read-only init paths do not mutate; missing-fence diagnostics give an exact recovery command; temporary packed-install tests cover custom tracker roots, worktrees/clones, opt-out, idempotence, and conflict recovery.
Initialize a fresh git workspace with pm init, create divergent branch edits to one item, and merge without separately running pm merge install; raw item and history conflicts occur.

Fresh init establishes shared merge attributes and clone-local drivers by default, next steps explain per-clone setup, opt-out is explicit, and reconcile/validate guidance names pm merge install when the fence is absent.
Fresh init neither installs nor surfaces the merge fence, so the default multi-agent branch workflow hard-conflicts despite complete merge-driver machinery.
workspace initialization and semantic merge safety
Agents following the default onboarding path can hit raw conflicts and lose the conflict-free multi-agent guarantee.
